source_description: QA bug reward [normal] to Tim: Zeta QA-7 (transitive bug from QA-5): basecamp 之前的 QA-5 fix 擋 manager 同時 in workers list (避免 dedup/double-credit) 但 cmd_assign 嚴格檢查 'target in workers' → 連同 §3.1 manager fallback 一起擋了 (overshot). meadow ws-...2779 solo session 自我 assign 不通過, Tasks 0/0 done 但實際有做 §19.9-§19.11 work. Fix: cmd_assign 允許 --to manager_persona 作合法 fallback target; 順帶加 add-worker subcmd 解 mid-session worker join 痛點 (之前 meadow 手動 edit JSON 才能 join). (ref: work-session-prototype-qa5-overshoot-manager-fallback-blocked)
